facades.name: Damrak front
facades.note: Bands: the three basement lights; the arched shop window and the entrance fanlight; first storey three SW-bay windows (the middle a pair) and two NE-bay windows; second storey three SW-bay windows and the NE bay's wide window; third storey the three arcade windows and the NE bay's arched window; the gable window and the spired dormer. Axes (x/50.2 + 0.25 from the SW corner): 1.3, 2.7, 4.0 in the SW bay, 5.7 and 6.5 in the NE bay (one wide window and the arched window and dormer on 6.3). Columns counted as 4: the three SW-bay axes and the NE bay's one axis (entrance, wide window, arched window and dormer all on it); its first-storey pair is two lights of one bay, 0.8 m apart, not two axes.
